surfaces.name: Tendril desktop app (Ivy framework UI; macOS pkg, Windows exe, Linux AppImage)
Tendril web server (tendril --web, optional Cloudflare tunnel)
Tendril REST API and inbox webhook

claims.answer: Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, a headless web server reachable through an optional Cloudflare tunnel (phone browser), a CLI and a VS Code extension; no native mobile app.

desktop_os.answer: Release v1.2.4 attaches osx pkg (arm64, x64), win exe (x64, arm64) and Linux AppImage (x64, arm64) installers.

mobile_apps.answer: No iOS or Android app in the repository or release assets; mobile steering is through a tunnel URL.

browser.answer: tendril --web starts the server without the desktop shell and the UI is served to a browser.

mobile_browser.answer: README advertises monitoring and steering from anywhere over a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel and the dashboard shows a QR code; mobile layout behaviour is not documented.

cli.answer: tendril CLI with plan, job, project, config, vault, doctor and mcp commands.

editor_extensions.answer: Ivy Tendril VS Code extension 0.1.0 with dashboard webview, worktree view and native diffs.

task_actions.answer: Create plans, execute, annotate, revise, stop, rerun, force start, approve to a PR and discard.

notifications.answer: Settings include a desktop notifications switch; no mobile push or chat notifications found.

cross_device_continuity.answer: The server owns plans and jobs, so another browser can connect through the tunnel; sharing requires the host machine to stay on.

limitations: No native iOS or Android app; mobile use is the web UI through a tunnel (README: Remote and Mobile Coding); VS Code extension is 0.1.0.

claims.answer: Provider implementations for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, OpenCode, Antigravity and an Ivy CLI agent, plus an OpenAI-compatible proxy; Tendril launches each agent CLI in a terminal session and parses its events; README says any CLI agent runs.

harnesses.answer: Docs list Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini and OpenCode; source has Antigravity, Ivy and OpenAiProxy providers too.

model_providers.answer: Model providers are chosen through OpenCode or agent environment variables (Bedrock, custom base URLs).

custom_adapters.answer: README claims any terminal CLI agent works; the documented adapters are the named providers and OpenAiProxy.

session_integration.answer: Agents run through PTY and event parsers with cost parsers per provider.

mixed_harness_operation.answer: The coding agent and profiles are set per project or plan (default codingAgent); mixing agents inside one plan is not described.

limitations: Not fully established: custom_adapters, mixed_harness_operation.

claims.answer: Agents run on their own sign-ins; Bedrock, custom endpoints and OpenCode providers carry API routes; no vendor credits.

agent_subscriptions.answer: Onboarding requires the coding agent installed and authorised on the machine.

api_accounts.answer: Environment variables per agent allow Bedrock or custom API endpoints; OpenCode providers use keys.

vendor_credits.answer: No credit system found in docs or source.

local_models.answer: OpenCode and the OpenAiProxy provider can point at other endpoints; local-model setup is not documented.

account_switching.answer: Agent profiles switch model and effort; multi-account switching is not described.

provider_restrictions.answer: No documentation of provider terms for subscription use through Tendril.

limitations: Not fully established: vendor_credits, local_models, account_switching, provider_restrictions.
claims.unknownReason: Provider terms are third-party facts outside the repository.

claims.answer: One-line install, onboarding wizard, then register projects and repos; GitHub features need gh; no managed cloud, but Docker and server password support exist.

first_task_setup.answer: Install script, run tendril, complete the onboarding wizard, register a project and create a plan.

no_git.answer: Projects are repositories and execution uses git worktrees; behaviour in a non-Git folder is not documented.

local_git_without_remote.answer: Worktree execution works on local repos; PR steps need a remote.

hosted_git.answer: GitHub through gh: issue import, PR creation and status sync.

prerequisite_guidance.answer: Docs say the coding agent must be installed and authorised and onboarding prompts when gh is missing.

managed_cloud_setup.answer: No hosted service found; the product is a local app.

byo_vps_onboarding.answer: Dockerfile and the server-password settings support a hosted install; no dedicated VPS installer.

limitations: Not fully established: managed_cloud_setup, byo_vps_onboarding, no_git.

evidence.title: README.md
evidence.finding: Agentic software factory desktop app: parallel git worktrees, Cloudflare Quick Tunnels for remote and mobile steering, Whisper voice input, plan annotations, code review with verification gates, GitHub issue and jam.dev inbox; works with any CLI agent; installers for macOS, Windows, Linux; FSL-1.1-ALv2.

evidence.title: LICENSE
evidence.locator: Functional Source License 1.1, ALv2 Future License
evidence.finding: FSL-1.1-ALv2, copyright Ivy Interactive: any purpose except Competing Use; each version converts to Apache-2.0 on the second anniversary.

evidence.title: AGENTS.md
evidence.finding: Development targets the development branch; main updated by release merges.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/01_GettingStarted/01_Introduction.md
evidence.finding: Local-first desktop app orchestrating Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini and OpenCode through plans and promptwares from idea to merged pull request; jobs dashboard with tokens and cost; verification gates; code never leaves the machine.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/01_GettingStarted/02_Installation.md
evidence.finding: curl and PowerShell install scripts download the pkg, AppImage or Windows installer; run tendril; coding agent must be installed and authorised first.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/02_Concepts/01_Plans.md
evidence.locator: Plan States; Creating a Plan; Plan Structure; Revisions
evidence.finding: Plans are folders (plan.yaml, revisions, verification, artifacts, worktrees, costs.csv) moving through Draft, Blocked, Creating, Executing, Updating, Review, Failed, Completed, Skipped, Icebox; created from drafts, inbox files or recommendations.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/02_Concepts/02_Promptwares.md
evidence.finding: Promptwares (CreatePlan, ExecutePlan, UpdatePlan, ExpandPlan, SplitPlan, CreatePr, CreateIssue) are folders with Program.md, Tools and Memory, run through the configured coding agent.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/02_Concepts/03_Lifecycle.md
evidence.finding: Job status values, build/format/test verification with failure limits, configurable parallel job slots on worktrees, per-plan costs.csv aggregated by project, time and promptware.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/04_Apps/02_Review.md
evidence.finding: Review app shows diff, verification output, plan text and Git tab; actions Approve (Make PR), Needs work (Revise), Decline (Discard), Manually resolve.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/04_Apps/04_Jobs.md
evidence.finding: Jobs app shows status, type, tokens and live stdout/stderr; Stop, Rerun, Force Start (skips dependency checks), Debug, Delete.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/07_Integrations/01_Github.md
evidence.locator: Importing Issues; Automatic PR Creation; PR Status Sync
evidence.finding: Import GitHub issues as plans (up to 1000 per fetch), CreatePr pushes a branch and opens a PR via gh, PrStatusSyncService updates plan state when PRs merge or close.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/07_Integrations/02_JamDev.md
evidence.finding: POST /api/inbox creates plans from jam.dev bug reports.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/03_Configuration/01_Setup.md
evidence.locator: Settings app; config.yaml; Password on a server; Verifications
evidence.finding: config.yaml with codingAgent, maxConcurrentJobs, projects, verifications, api.apiKey; BasicAuth env secrets for a server install; built-in verifications Build, Format, Test, Lint, Screenshots, CheckResult.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/06_CodingAgents/_Index.md
evidence.finding: Coding agents run with per-agent profiles (model, effort) and injected environment variables such as Bedrock or custom base URLs.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/08_ModelProviders/_Index.md
evidence.finding: Model providers are configured inside OpenCode and used by selecting OpenCode as the coding agent.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/09_Advanced/02_REST.md
evidence.finding: REST API at the server URL (default https://localhost:5010); X-Api-Key header when api.apiKey is set, otherwise routes are open.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/09_Advanced/03_MCP.md
evidence.finding: tendril mcp stdio server exposes plan tools (tendril_get_plan, list_plans, inbox, plan_set, add_repo) to agents; TENDRIL_MCP_TOKEN optional.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril.Docs/Docs/05_ReleaseNotes/01_ReleaseNotes.md
evidence.finding: Release notes: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel QR code on the dashboard, Share Mode tunnel beta, session password protection, beta-flag isolation.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril/TELEMETRY.md
evidence.finding: Opt-out PostHog telemetry on by default, disabled with telemetry: false in settings; random anonymous GUID; aggregate non-identifying data only.

evidence.finding: CLI commands for plan create/get/set/list, dependsOn, worktrees, verification, job start/status/cancel, vault, config, doctor, mcp, promptware run and memory.

evidence.title: src/Ivy.Tendril/Services/Plans/DependencyChecker.cs
